integrity: Original mathematical proof and program are self-contained. Numerical tests supplement but do not replace the infinite proof. No independent scientific validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only consecutive unweighted coordinate-sum functionals for Hilbert unilateral shifts are classified. Interval-supported equality is unique up to a phase; nonzero tails excluded from uniqueness. Search incompleteness remains a bibliographic risk.
title: Sharp parity law for finite interval functionals in the numerical-radius shift norm
